hero.title: Master pharmacy,
hero.subtitle: PharmaSpace brings your Lectures, Exams, TDs, TPs and Mind Maps into one calm, focused place — so you spend less time searching and more time learning.

about.title: Built by pharmacy students, for pharmacy students
about.subtitle: PharmaSpace is a study companion designed to make pharmacy learning faster, clearer, and more organized.
about.body: We combine AI-powered summaries, mind maps, and structured QCM practice into one focused workspace. Whether you're revising a chapter or preparing for exams, PharmaSpace keeps everything in one place — so you can spend less time searching and more time learning.

study.title: Structured study, without the clutter.
study.subtitle: Everything you need for a chapter, organised the way pharmacy is actually taught — no noise, no distractions.
study.feature1: Curated notes aligned with your curriculum
study.feature2: Flashcards with spaced repetition built in
study.feature3: Search across every subject in seconds

exams.title: Practice the way you'll be tested.
exams.subtitle: Realistic exam sessions with instant feedback, so you know exactly where you stand before the real thing.
exams.feature1: Timed mock exams that mirror your faculty format
exams.feature3: Track accuracy per subject and topic

mindmaps.title: See how everything connects.
mindmaps.subtitle: Turn dense chapters into clear, visual maps you can actually remember — from mechanisms to interactions.
mindmaps.feature1: Interactive maps for every major chapter
mindmaps.feature2: Link drugs, classes, and mechanisms visually
mindmaps.feature3: Zoom, collapse, and revise at your own pace

progress.title: Know exactly where you're improving.
progress.subtitle: Simple, honest analytics that show your strengths, your weak spots, and what to focus on next.

pricing.title: One plan. Everything unlocked.
pricing.subtitle: Simple yearly pricing. No hidden fees
pricing.feature2: Full exam bank with instant feedback
pricing.feature3: Interactive mind maps for every chapter
pricing.feature5: Priority support from the PharmaSpace team

cta.title: Ready to study smarter?
cta.subtitle: Join pharmacy students already using PharmaSpace to make every study session count.
cta.footnote: Free to try · No credit card required
